_ordering_rationale: Franklin Resources (Franklin Templeton). Asset manager. Ordre par PV : AUM total (taille gestionnaire) > IM fees (CA principal) > S&D fees (distribution) > Effective fee rate (compression marges) > Alternative AUM (segment haute fee).

kpis.signal: Plateau post intégration Putnam, sorties WAM 141.9 Mds$ FY25
kpis.description_fr: AUM total Franklin Templeton fin d'exercice (30 sept). Acquisition Putnam (148.3 Mds$) en jan 2024 a porté AUM à 1678.6 Mds$, FY25 légère baisse à 1661.2 Mds$ malgré marché favorable due aux outflows Western Asset Management.
kpis.description_en: Franklin Templeton total AUM at fiscal year-end (Sep 30). Putnam acquisition ($148.3B) Jan 2024 pushed AUM to $1678.6B, FY25 slight dip to $1661.2B despite favorable markets due to Western Asset Management outflows.

kpis.signal: 80% du CA, croissance modeste, compression effective fee rate
kpis.description_fr: Commissions de gestion BEN, principale source de revenus (~80% Total Operating Revenues). FY25 6.98 Mds$ (+2%), modeste vs croissance AUM, reflet compression effective fee rate 41.1bps -> 40.5bps.
kpis.description_en: BEN investment management fees, primary revenue source (~80% of total operating revenues). FY25 $6.98B (+2%), modest vs AUM growth, reflecting effective fee rate compression 41.1bps -> 40.5bps.

kpis.signal: Rebond vs creux FY23, sensible aux flux retail funds
kpis.description_fr: Commissions de distribution et ventes (rétrocessions courtiers, frais d'entrée mutual funds). Cyclique avec collecte retail, ~17% Total Operating Revenues FY25.
kpis.description_en: Sales and distribution fees (broker rebates, mutual fund front-end loads). Cyclical with retail gathering, ~17% of total operating revenues FY25.

kpis.signal: Compression structurelle, mix equity & catch-up fees PE
kpis.description_fr: Taux de commission effectif (IM fees hors performance / AUM moyen) en basis points. FY25 40.5 bps vs 41.1 bps FY24. Baisse due à mix shift equity products low-fee + non-récurrence catch-up fees secondary PE fund + outflows WAM (lower-fee).
kpis.description_en: Effective management fee rate (IM fees ex-performance / average AUM) in basis points. FY25 40.5 bps vs 41.1 bps FY24. Decline due to equity low-fee product mix shift + non-recurring catch-up fees in secondary PE fund + WAM lower-fee outflows.

kpis.signal: Segment high-fee croissant (Lexington PE, BSP credit, Alcentra)
kpis.description_fr: AUM alternatifs (private equity Lexington Partners, alternative credit Benefit Street + Alcentra, real estate, infrastructure). Segment haute commission, +5.6% FY25, levier de re-diversification fee mix vs equity/fixed income low-fee.
kpis.description_en: Alternative AUM (private equity Lexington Partners, alternative credit Benefit Street + Alcentra, real estate, infrastructure). High-fee segment, +5.6% FY25, key lever for fee mix re-diversification vs low-fee equity/fixed income.
